infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Marcus does not read your health data.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Marcus syncs your daily Stoic practice as Mindful Minutes so your reflection time is counted alongside meditation and breathwork.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Marcus uses FaceID to keep your journal entries, reflections, and emotion logs private when others have access to your device.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Marcus uses motion data to subtly animate the skull on the practice screen, so it appears to follow you as you tilt your phone.
